description: Hazard zones due to volcanic activity at Svartsengi and Grindavík is a dataset listed in Icelandic geoportal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by gis.lmi.is. Delimitation of hazard zones due to volcanic activity at Svartsengi and Grindavík that began in November 2023. Within each area, a hazard assessment is carried out, based on an assessment by experts of the Icelandic Meteorological Office and the Institute of Earth Sciences at the University of Iceland. Coverage: IS. Its keywords include opin gögn, eldgos, Reykjanes. The listing shows 6 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2023-11-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-is.
